title: Affine ind-étale test objects
statement:
Let $W$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and use the small pro-étale sites and size conventions of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. A test object of $W_{\Proet}$ is a morphism $u_B:B\to W$ factoring as $B\to V\hookrightarrow W$ through an affine open subscheme $V\subseteq W$ [def-weil-open-immersion], where, over $V$,
$$
B=\varprojlim_{i\in I}B_i
$$
is a small nonempty cofiltered limit of affine schemes $B_i$ with affine transition maps [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and every $B_i\to V$ is étale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Here cofiltered means that $I^{\mathrm{op}}$ is filtered, and the presentation is a limit over $V$ in the sense of [sk-def-pe-morphisms]. Equivalently, on writing $V=\operatorname{Spec}R$ and $B_i=\operatorname{Spec}C_i$, its source is $\operatorname{Spec}(\varinjlim_{I^{\mathrm{op}}}C_i)$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-small-colimit-limit]; thus $B\to V$ is affine pro-étale in the terminology of [sk-def-pe-morphisms]. Such a morphism $u_B$ is weakly étale [det-pe-morphisms-etale-comparison, lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-etale, sk-lem-pe-weakly-etale-stability], so $B\to W$ is an object of $W_{\Proet}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site].

Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and an integer $n\geq1$, and put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For $T=W,B$, let $A_T$ be the constant coefficient sheaf and let $D(T_{\Proet},A)$ be the ordinary unbounded derived category of $A_T$-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. The restriction of $K\in D(W_{\Proet},A)$ to a test object is, by definition,
$$
Lu^*_{B,A}K\in D(B_{\Proet},A),
$$
where $Lu^*_{B,A}$ is the derived module inverse image of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] for $u_B$ with the canonical coefficient identification $u_B^{-1}A_W\xrightarrow{\sim}A_B$ of [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map].
